# Existing sequence posters

These are the exact image SVGs returned by Sequence contract
`0x9423548a957284eD17E55c37c4B6D96e5E63065f` for IDs 5, 7 and 8 on 2026-10-29.
They contain only static shapes/text, without scripts, external references,
embedded images, foreign objects, entities or a DTD.

The corresponding `server/assets/sequence-*-poster.png` files were rendered
locally at 1200×630 with JavaScript disabled and all network requests blocked.
The server selects them only by the input SHA-256 in `known-sequence-poster.ts`.
Changed artwork receives the ordinary static fallback until reviewed again.
No SVG parsing or artwork script execution is added to the server runtime.
